units.source_text: 历年红叶节都举办文学性的活动。

en.t: Every year the Maple Festival held literary events.

units.source_text: 名人逝世的昭和十五年，红叶节尤为盛大。

en.t: In Showa 15, the year the master died, the Maple Festival was especially grand.

units.source_text: 除尾崎红叶外，还有高山樗牛、坪内逍遥，都同热海结下了不解之缘。

en.t: Besides Ozaki Koyo, Takayama Chogyu and Tsubouchi Shoyo also formed deep, inseparable ties with Atami.

units.source_text: 为了悼念这三位已故文人，竹田敏彦、大佛次郎、林房雄等三位小说家在前一年度的作品里又对热海作了介绍。

en.t: To mourn these three late literary figures, the three novelists Takeda Toshihiko, Osaragi Jiro, and Hayashi Fusao again introduced Atami in works from the previous year.

units.source_text: 热海市给这三位作家赠送了感谢状。

en.t: The city of Atami presented letters of thanks to these three writers.

units.source_text: 当时我正在热海，也出席了这个节日的活动。

en.t: At the time I was in Atami, and I also attended the festival events.
